title: Complete Web Development Bootcamp
shortDescription: Learn modern web development from HTML, CSS and JavaScript to React, Node.js and MongoDB.
description: A complete web development course designed for beginners who want to become job-ready full-stack developers.

title: React JS From Beginner to Advanced
shortDescription: Master React.js from the fundamentals to advanced concepts and build real-world applications.
description: Learn React.js step by step including components, hooks, state management, routing and API integration.

title: Next.js Full Stack Development
shortDescription: Build modern full-stack applications with Next.js, React, APIs, authentication and databases.
description: A practical Next.js course covering App Router, server components, API routes, authentication and full-stack development.

title: JavaScript Mastery
shortDescription: Build a strong JavaScript foundation and master modern ES6+ features through practical projects.
description: Learn JavaScript fundamentals, ES6+, DOM manipulation, asynchronous programming and modern JavaScript development.

title: UI/UX Design with Figma
shortDescription: Learn UI/UX design principles and create professional designs and prototypes using Figma.
description: A beginner-friendly UI/UX design course covering user research, wireframing, visual design and Figma prototyping.

title: Node.js & Express Backend Development
shortDescription: Learn backend development with Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs, authentication and MongoDB.
description: Build scalable backend applications using Node.js and Express with REST APIs, authentication and database integration.

title: MongoDB Database Fundamentals
shortDescription: Learn MongoDB database fundamentals, CRUD operations, queries, aggregation and database design.
description: Understand MongoDB from the basics and learn how to design, query and manage NoSQL databases effectively.

title: Git & GitHub for Developers
shortDescription: Master Git and GitHub for version control, collaboration and professional software development.
description: Learn Git commands, branching, merging, pull requests, GitHub workflows and collaborative development.
